## Question

Which start, optimizer and PSD route should each estimation route use by
default? Every fit is judged by the library verdict, on simulated problems the
candidates were not developed on.

## The register

Status as of the pre-registration commit; the lanes have not run yet.

| Default | Current value | Candidate | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ML and GLS start | transported FABIN3 (ML), native FABIN3 (GLS) | layered | open | lane `ml-gls` (pending); engineering/17 corpus |
| ML and GLS optimizer | NLopt L-BFGS | PORT | open | lane `ml-gls` (pending); engineering/17 corpus |
| optimizer coordinates | information-refined sample units | none | settled 2026-09-26 on the corpus; confirmed out of sample by lane `ml-gls` (pending) | engineering/17 |
| PSD cold start | transported FABIN3 | layered | open | lane `psd-ml` (pending) |
| PSD preconditioning | lifted information diagonal | none | provisional | lane `psd-ml` (pending) |
| PSD route | direct PSD fit | two-stage | open, author decides after the lane | lane `psd-ml` (pending) |
| PSD feasibility tolerances | absolute, in covariance units | relative to sample units | open, fix if the lane shows they bite | lane `psd-ml` (pending) |

Criteria: [criteria/ml-gls.md](criteria/ml-gls.md) and
[criteria/psd-ml.md](criteria/psd-ml.md).
